papers.title_en: Founders for hire? The role of venture studios in breaking the individual-opportunity nexus
papers.title_zh: 雇佣创始人？风险工作室在打破个体-机会关系中的作用
papers.abstract_en: Entrepreneurship theory has often posited the founder as the central agent of venture creation; from identifying opportunities, to mobilizing resources, and driving execution. We examine how venture studios – organizations that systematically create new ventures by taking over traditionally founder-led processes – challenge this assumption. Drawing on an inductive multiple case study of 16 venture studios with 50 primary and secondary interviews, we reveal how venture studios develop and validate ideas independently from founders prior to recruiting them, and how they coordinate the entrepreneurial process when these functions are separated. Our findings contribute to the literature on the individual-opportunity nexus, the entrepreneurial process and open the research agenda on venture studios as a new phenomenon in entrepreneurship. • Venture studios challenge the assumption that founder and idea are connected. • We provide qualitative evidence from 16 venture studios using 50 interviews. • Venture studios disentangle opportunity discovery from venture creation. • They coordinate the entrepreneurial process through managerial mechanisms. • Venture studios shift entrepreneurial agency from individual to the organization.
papers.abstract_zh: 创业理论常常将创始人视为创业的核心主体；从识别机会，到动员资源，再到推动执行。我们研究了创业工作室——这些组织通过接管传统上由创始人领导的过程来系统地创造新企业——如何挑战这一假设。基于对16家创业工作室的归纳性多案例研究以及50次主要和次要访谈，我们揭示了创业工作室如何在招募创始人之前独立开发和验证想法，以及当这些功能被分离时，它们如何协调创业过程。我们的发现为个体-机会关系、创业过程的文献做出了贡献，并开启了将创业工作室作为创业新现象的研究议程。• 创业工作室挑战了创始人与想法相连的假设。• 我们提供了来自16家创业工作室的50次访谈的定性证据。• 创业工作室将机会发现与创业创造分开。• 它们通过管理机制协调创业过程。• 创业工作室将创业主体从个体转移到组织。

papers.title_en: Mapping artificial intelligence research in the cultural and creative industries: A systematic bibliometric review
papers.title_zh: 标题：在文化创意产业中绘制人工智能研究：一项系统的文献计量学综述
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence is reshaping creativity, labor, and authorship in the cultural and creative industries (CCIs), yet management and innovation scholarship on this transformation remains fragmented and theoretically underdeveloped. This bibliometric review addresses two interrelated gaps and maps the intellectual structure and thematic evolution of AI research in CCIs from a management and innovation perspective. Empirically, prior reviews focus on technical performance or ethical issues without integrating organizational perspectives. Conceptually, research on creativity, authorship, labor, and ethics remains fragmented and lacks frameworks linking technological capabilities to organizational and cultural implications. Following PRISMA 2020, 135 peer-reviewed journal articles from Scopus and Web of Science (2014-2025) were analyzed using performance analysis, science-mapping techniques, and text-mining-assisted content analysis. Five major clusters were identified: Art and Digital Creativity, Technology and Innovation, Creative Industries Practice, Legal and Intellectual Property, and Cultural Heritage. Output increased sharply, with more than half of the articles published in 2025. Art and Digital Creativity dominates the field, Legal and Intellectual Property shows disproportionate influence, and Cultural Heritage remains underexamined. Bibliographic coupling of 75 connected papers yielded 24 subclusters, indicating conceptual fragmentation and limited theoretical integration. Current scholarship draws heavily on copyright economics and deep learning foundations of generative AI, but remains weakly connected to organizational aesthetics, reflexivity, and identity theory. This review consolidates the knowledge base and provides a roadmap for future research on human-AI co-creativity, ethical governance, and aesthetic labor transformation. • First bibliometric map of AI research across cultural and creative industries. • 135 peer-reviewed articles analyzed from 2014 to 2025. • 52% of publications appeared in 2025, showing reactive scholarship. • 24 clusters across 75 connected papers reveal strong fragmentation. • Research agenda links artistic, legal, organizational, and ethical issues.
papers.abstract_zh: 人工智能正在重塑文化和创意产业（CCIs）中的创造力、劳动和作者身份，但关于这一转型的管理与创新学术研究仍然支离破碎且理论发展不足。这篇文献计量综述解决了两个相互关联的空白，并从管理和创新的角度绘制了人工智能在CCIs研究的知识结构和主题演变。从实证角度来看，先前的综述侧重于技术性能或伦理问题，没有整合组织视角。从概念上讲，关于创造力、作者身份、劳动和伦理的研究仍然支离破碎，缺乏将技术能力与组织和文化影响联系起来的框架。遵循PRISMA 2020标准，分析了2014-2025年间Scopus和Web of Science中的135篇同行评审期刊文章，使用了绩效分析、科学绘图技术和文本挖掘辅助内容分析。识别出五个主要集群：艺术与数字创造力、技术与创新、创意产业实践、法律与知识产权、文化遗产。产出急剧增加，超过一半的文章在2025年发表。艺术与数字创造力主导了该领域，法律与知识产权显示出不成比例的影响力，而文化遗产仍然未得到充分研究。75篇相关论文的文献耦合产生了24个子集群，表明概念碎片化和有限的理论整合。当前学术研究严重依赖版权经济学和生成性人工智能的深度学习基础，但与组织美学、反思性和身份理论的联系较弱。这篇综述整合了知识基础，并为未来关于人工智能共同创造力、伦理治理和审美劳动转型的研究提供了路线图。• 首次绘制人工智能在文化和创意产业研究的文献计量地图。• 2014至2025年间分析了135篇同行评审文章。• 52%的出版物出现在2025年，显示出反应性学术研究。• 75篇相关论文中的24个集群揭示了强烈的碎片化。• 研究议程将艺术、法律、组织和伦理问题联系起来。

papers.title_en: The role of AI for sustainability and economic performance: Evidence from the pharmaceutical industry
papers.title_zh: 人工智能在可持续性与经济绩效中的作用：来自制药行业的证据
papers.abstract_en: In today's rapidly evolving business landscape, organizations across industries are increasingly seeking to capitalize on the opportunities offered by digital transformation, particularly through Artificial Intelligence (AI). Yet, many organizations struggle to fully harness the potential of these emerging technologies. This study contributes to the ongoing discourse on the organizational factors that drive effective AI adoption, focusing on how organizational readiness influences AI adoption and performance. Specifically, we explore the relationship between Strategic and Cognitive readiness and AI adoption, examining their roles in advancing Sustainability and Economic outcomes. Using data from 511 employees in the pharmaceutical industry and employing Structural Equation Modeling, our analysis reveals that (i) strategic and cognitive readiness positively influence AI adoption; (ii) AI adoption mediates the positive relation between strategic and cognitive readiness and SDG performance; (iii) SDGs attainment mediates the relationship between AI adoption and economic performance; (iv) SDGs performance enhances economic performance; and that (v) this relationship is more pronounced in smaller organizations. Our findings contribute to the ongoing research on the organizational determinants of effective AI adoption and highlight the critical role of this technology in supporting both SDGs achievement and economic viability. • Organizational readiness for digital innovation leads to enhanced AI adoption levels. • AI adoption leads to enhanced Economic Performance, mediated by SDGs attainment. • SDGs attainment leads to enhanced Economic Performance. • Small Organizational Size moderates the effect between SDGs and Economic outcomes.
papers.abstract_zh: 在当今快速变化的商业环境中，各行各业的组织越来越寻求利用数字化转型提供的机会，特别是通过人工智能（AI）。然而，许多组织难以充分发挥这些新兴技术的潜力。本研究为关于推动有效AI采纳的组织因素的持续讨论做出贡献，重点关注组织准备度如何影响AI采纳和绩效。具体来说，我们探讨了战略和认知准备度与AI采纳之间的关系，检验它们在推进可持续性发展和经济成果方面的作用。利用来自制药行业511名员工的数据，并采用结构方程模型，我们的分析揭示了：（i）战略和认知准备度对AI采纳有积极影响；（ii）AI采纳在战略和认知准备度与可持续发展目标（SDG）绩效之间起中介作用；（iii）SDG绩效在AI采纳与经济绩效之间起中介作用；（iv）SDG绩效增强了经济绩效；以及（v）这种关系在小型组织中更为明显。我们的发现为关于有效AI采纳的组织决定因素的持续研究做出贡献，并强调了这项技术在支持SDGs实现和经济可行性方面的关键作用。• 数字创新的组织准备度导致AI采纳水平提高。• AI采纳通过SDGs绩效的中介作用增强了经济绩效。• SDGs绩效增强了经济绩效。• 组织规模小调节了SDGs与经济成果之间的关系。

papers.title_en: Knowledge spillovers from local innovative industrial clusters: A business group network perspective
papers.title_zh: 来自本地创新产业集群的知识溢出：企业集团网络视角
papers.abstract_en: Transcending the spatial “stickiness” of knowledge is essential for mitigating regional innovation gaps, yet the mechanisms by which localized cluster externalities diffuse across regions remain underexplored. Integrating the organisational embeddedness perspective with agglomeration theory, this study investigates how business group networks internalise and redistribute knowledge generated by local innovative industrial clusters. We exploit China's National Innovative Industrial Cluster Pilot (NIICP) policy as a quasi-experimental policy setting, and leverage a matched panel dataset of Chinese A-share listed firms and their domestic subsidiaries over 2009-2022. The results demonstrate that the development of local innovative industrial clusters generates significant internalised cluster spillovers within business groups, thereby enhancing the innovation performance of affiliated firms. These effects are spatially asymmetric: non-local affiliates benefit substantially, whereas the impact on local affiliates is limited. Mechanism analysis reveals three main channels through which cluster development affects affiliated firms: internal knowledge coordination and integration within business groups, external agglomeration of innovation resources, and competitive crowding-out within clusters. Further analysis shows that the spillover effects are stronger when intra-group linkages are tighter or when host regions of non-local affiliates are characterised by weaker institutional environments. These findings challenge purely geographic views of agglomeration, suggesting that multi-locational organisational networks are critical for overcoming the spatial trap of innovation resources. • China's NIICP cluster pilots provide a quasi-natural experiment. • Business group networks internalise and transmit cluster knowledge. • Cluster policies raise innovation in non-local affiliates more than local ones. • Spillovers operate through internal coordination, external resources and crowding out. • Strong intra-group linkages and weak institutions amplify internalised spillover effects.
papers.abstract_zh: 超越知识的地域“粘性”对于缩小区域创新差距至关重要，但本地集群外部性如何跨区域扩散的机制尚未充分探索。本研究将组织嵌入视角与集聚理论相结合，探讨企业集团网络如何内部化和重新分配由本地创新产业集群产生的知识。我们利用中国国家创新型产业集群试点（NIICP）政策作为准实验政策环境，并利用2009-2022年中国A股上市公司及其国内子公司的匹配面板数据集。结果表明，本地创新产业集群的发展在企业集团内部产生了显著的内部化集群溢出效应，从而提高了关联企业的创新绩效。这些效应在空间上是不对称的：非本地子公司受益显著，而对本地子公司的影响有限。机制分析揭示了集群发展影响关联企业的三个主要渠道：企业集团内部知识协调和整合、创新资源的外部集聚以及集群内的竞争挤出。进一步分析表明，当集团内部联系更紧密或非本地子公司的东道地区以较弱的制度环境为特征时，溢出效应更强。这些发现挑战了纯粹的地理集聚观，表明多地点组织网络对于克服创新资源的空间陷阱至关重要。•中国的NIICP集群试点提供了一个准自然实验。•企业集团网络内部化和传递集群知识。•集群政策提高了非本地子公司的创新能力，而本地子公司的创新能力提高较少。•溢出效应通过内部协调、外部资源和挤出效应发挥作用。•集团内部联系紧密和制度环境薄弱放大了内部化溢出效应。

papers.title_en: Artificial intelligence in trauma and emergency surgery: A quantitative study of perceived technology acceptance
papers.title_zh: 创伤和急诊外科中的人工智能：对感知技术接受度的定量研究
papers.abstract_en: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is a transformative technology capable of driving the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) implementation across various industries. It can play a crucial role in the healthcare sector, especially in highly specialized fields such as trauma and emergency surgery, where its potential to assist in clinical decision-making is gaining widespread recognition. When appropriately designed and governed, AI applications in surgery can contribute to SDG 3 by improving health outcomes and promoting well-being. Moreover, clearly defined accountability and responsibility frameworks for AI in healthcare support SDG 16 by enabling auditability, clarifying responsibility allocation, and fostering institutional trust through transparent governance mechanisms. Despite these opportunities, ethical and governance-related concerns remain central to AI adoption and significantly shape the attitudes of medical professionals, patients, technology providers, developers, and policymakers. This exploratory study investigates surgeons' perceptions regarding AI adoption through a framework informed by the Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT). While grounded in UTAUT, the study incorporates context-specific constructs that capture the unique challenges of surgical practice: performance expectancy, perceived diagnostic complexity, patient-centered communication orientation, responsible AI governance climate, and shared accountability perceptions. By examining how responsibility interacts with traditional UTAUT constructs, performance expectancy, effort expectancy, social influence, and facilitating conditions, this research offers a more context-sensitive understanding of AI adoption in high-stakes medical environments. Through a comprehensive survey endorsed by the World Society of Emergency Surgery (WSES), involving 624 physicians from 72 countries, we aim to highlight these concerns and propose a conceptual model that reconciles AI's technological advances with the ethical obligations to protect patients and ensure sustainable healthcare outcomes. • Artificial Intelligence (AI) is a transformative technology capable of driving the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals implementation across various industries. • AI can drive progress in healthcare and surgery, augmenting decision-making. • Ethical concerns can limit the effective use of clinical AI-based tools. • This research offers a more context-sensitive understanding of AI adoption in high-stakes medical environments.
papers.abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）是一项能够推动联合国可持续发展目标（SDGs）在各行业实施的变革性技术。它在医疗保健领域，特别是在创伤和急诊外科等高度专业化领域中，可以发挥关键作用，其在临床决策支持方面的潜力正获得广泛认可。当AI在外科手术中的应用得到适当设计和管理时，可以促进SDG 3目标的实现，通过改善健康结果和促进福祉。此外，为医疗保健中的AI明确定义的问责和责任框架支持SDG 16目标，通过使审计成为可能、明确责任分配，并通过透明的治理机制促进制度信任。尽管存在这些机会，与AI采用相关的伦理和治理问题仍然是核心问题，显著影响医疗专业人员、患者、技术提供商、开发者和政策制定者的态度。本探索性研究通过受统一接受和使用技术理论（UTAUT）指导的框架，调查外科医生对AI采用的看法。虽然基于UTAUT，但研究纳入了特定于上下文的构建，以捕捉外科实践的独特挑战：绩效期望、感知诊断复杂性、以患者为中心的沟通取向、负责任的AI治理氛围和共享责任感知。通过检查责任如何与传统UTAUT构建、绩效期望、努力期望、社会影响和促进条件相互作用，这项研究提供了对高风险医疗环境中AI采用更具有上下文敏感性的理解。通过由世界急诊外科学会（WSES）支持的全面调查，涉及来自72个国家的624名医生，我们旨在突出这些关注点，并提出一个概念模型，将AI的技术进步与保护患者和确保可持续医疗结果的伦理义务相协调。• 人工智能（AI）是一项能够推动联合国可持续发展目标在各行业实施的变革性技术。• AI可以推动医疗保健和外科手术的进步，增强决策制定。• 伦理问题可能限制临床AI工具的有效使用。• 这项研究提供了一个更具上下文敏感性的...

papers.title_en: Data-driven high-tech entrepreneurship: Empirical evidence from China
papers.title_zh: 数据驱动的高科技创业：来自中国的实证证据
papers.abstract_en: This study investigates whether and under what conditions open government data (OGD) promotes high-tech entrepreneurship. Drawing on panel data from 259 Chinese cities between 2007 and 2022, and leveraging the staggered rollout of OGD platforms as a quasi-natural experiment, we implement a multi-period difference-in-differences design. The results show that OGD significantly promotes high-tech entrepreneurship, with the most pronounced effect observed among medium-sized startups. These effects are more pronounced in regions with stronger development of digital technology and industrial co-agglomeration, and in regions with lower administrative monopoly and higher labor costs, while also stronger in industries with higher entry barriers, suggesting that OGD may serve as a critical informational resource that empowers startups to overcome resource constraints and entry barriers. • We conceptualize Open Government Data (OGD) as a quasi-public, non-rival production factor. • A multi-period DID exploiting staggered city-level OGD launches identifies causal effects on high-tech entrepreneurship. • OGD lowers entry barriers via a macro-level factor substitution mechanism that reduces reliance on capital-intensive inputs. • Effects are stronger where digital capabilities and industrial co-agglomeration are higher, revealing key boundary conditions. • OGD can act as an "institutional substitute," exerting a stronger pro-entrepreneurship effect in regions with weaker market institutions. • This study bridges the discourse between "open government" and "entrepreneurship," offering a new framework to assess the economic performance of digital-era public policies.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了在何种条件下开放政府数据（OGD）能够促进高科技创业。利用2007至2022年间259个中国城市的面板数据，并利用OGD平台的分阶段推出作为准自然实验，我们实施了多期差分-差分设计。结果显示，OGD显著促进了高科技创业，其中中型初创企业的效果最为明显。这些效应在数字技术发展和产业共聚更强的地区更为显著，在行政垄断较低和劳动力成本较高的地区也更强，同时在进入壁垒更高的行业中也更强，表明OGD可能作为一种关键的信息资源，赋予初创企业克服资源限制和进入壁垒的能力。•我们将开放政府数据（OGD）概念化为一种准公共的、非竞争性的生产要素。•多期DID利用分阶段的城市级OGD启动，识别了对高科技创业的因果效应。•OGD通过宏观层面的要素替代机制降低进入壁垒，减少对资本密集型投入的依赖。•在数字能力和产业共聚更高的地方，效应更强，揭示了关键的边界条件。•OGD可以作为一种“制度替代品”，在市场制度较弱的地区发挥更强的促进创业效应。•本研究将“开放政府”与“创业”之间的论述联系起来，为评估数字时代公共政策的经济绩效提供了一个新的框架。

papers.title_en: Wages, profits, inequality: wage-price spirals revisited
papers.title_zh: 工资、利润、不平等：重新审视工资-价格螺旋
papers.abstract_en: Abstract In times of inflation, the fear of so-called wage-price spirals becomes a central motif for policymaking. Yet, empirical studies on this phenomenon of spiraling input costs remain scarce. Lacking altogether is an assessment of the distributional effects of this form of cost-push inflation. Drawing on a standard sector-level cost-push inflation model, we examine the potential first- and second-round effects of a wage-price and wage-price-profit spiral scenario following the 2021 energy price spike as well as their distributional implications across 14 countries of the European Union. Our main results are threefold: first, we observe relatively small second-round effects, casting substantial doubt on the empirical validity of conventional wage-price spirals. Second, if sectors succeed in defending their profit margins while workers continue to defend their real wages, the emerging wage-price-profit adjustments may substantially add to inflationary pressures. Third, for the countries under consideration, wage-induced second-round effects appear to be progressive and substantially more benign than the regressive first-round effects of the energy price increases. This raises the question of whether second-round effects are a price worth paying.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要：在通货膨胀时期，对所谓的工资-价格螺旋的担忧成为政策制定的核心主题。然而，关于这种螺旋式投入成本现象的实证研究仍然很少。完全缺乏对这种成本推动型通货膨胀的分配效应的评估。基于一个标准的部门层面成本推动型通货膨胀模型，我们检验了2021年能源价格飙升后工资-价格和工资-价格-利润螺旋情景的潜在第一和第二轮效应及其在14个欧盟国家的分配影响。我们的主要结果有三个方面：首先，我们观察到相对较小的第二轮效应，对传统工资-价格螺旋的经验有效性提出了严重质疑。其次，如果部门成功维护其利润率，而工人继续维护其实质工资，那么新出现的工资-价格-利润调整可能会显著增加通胀压力。第三，对于所考虑的国家，工资诱导的第二轮效应似乎是累进的，并且比能源价格上涨的第一轮效应的累退性要温和得多。这引发了一个问题，即第二轮效应是否值得付出代价。

papers.title_en: Competitiveness divergence in the euro area: rediscovering Kaldorian cumulative causation
papers.title_zh: 欧元区竞争力分化：重新发现卡尔多累积因果关系
papers.abstract_en: Abstract In recent decades, models of circular and cumulative causation (CC), based on the endogenous relationships between prices, exports, and labor productivity, have lost prominence in explaining economic dynamics, such as the divergence within the euro area. We argue that the combination of price-sensitive exports and the triggering effect of exports on productivity can enable feedback loops, significantly shaping macroeconomic reality in the short-to-medium run. We apply an adapted model of export-led CC to 10 major countries belonging to the euro area, a region characterized by divergent wage growth trajectories, reflected in divergent export competitiveness and a lack of equilibrating mechanisms. Using quarterly data over the period 1995–2020, we estimate a system of equations combining autoregressive distributed lag and instrumental variable techniques to identify causal relationships among key variables. Our findings suggest that the price-export-productivity mechanism has amplified productivity disparities within the euro area, reinforcing divergence. While wages act as a potential trigger through their impact on price competitiveness, they also serve as a central factor that retards the feedback mechanism due to the indirect scale effect of wage-induced domestic demand. Overall, our results affirm the significance of export-led CC while also delineating its limitations.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 近几十年来，基于价格、出口和劳动生产率之间内生关系的循环累积因果（CC）模型在解释经济动态，如欧元区内部的分化现象时已不再突出。我们认为，价格敏感型出口和出口对生产率的触发效应可以形成反馈循环，在短期至中期内显著塑造宏观经济现实。我们将一个调整后的出口导向型CC模型应用于属于欧元区的10个主要国家，该地区以工资增长轨迹的分化为特征，反映在出口竞争力的分化和缺乏均衡机制上。利用1995-2020年期间的季度数据，我们估计了一个结合自回归分布滞后和工具变量技术的方程系统，以识别关键变量之间的因果关系。我们的发现表明，价格-出口-生产率机制放大了欧元区内生产率差异，加强了分化。虽然工资通过其对价格竞争力的影响充当潜在触发因素，但它们也由于工资引发的国内需求的间接规模效应，成为阻碍反馈机制的中心因素。总体而言，我们的结果证实了出口导向型CC的重要性，同时也界定了其局限性。

papers.title_en: Technological trajectories formatting the socio-institutional framework—the case of the addictive empire of the techno-oligarchs
papers.title_zh: 技术轨迹塑造社会制度框架——技术寡头成瘾帝国案例
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Although the literature on technological change often discusses its social effects, it typically focusses either on the strictly technological dynamics of innovation or on the mismatch and rematch between its trajectory and the dominant socio-institutional framework. The explanation of the rematch is commonly associated with the collapse of the previous social restrictions, given the prevailing institutions’ inability to propel capital accumulation in the key-factor and carrier sectors and therefore to promote the expansion of the new techno-economic paradigm. This paper suggests a reappraisal of that view, exploring how a new technology, hyper-communication and social media, is reshaping the power relations, with the emergence of a techno-oligarchy. We conclude that this is a case of a technology molding the previous social framework through adaptation and creating new institutions and culture, which lead to a deep transformation, including of the status of human agency.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要：尽管关于技术变革的文献经常讨论其社会效应，但通常要么关注创新的严格技术动态，要么关注其轨迹与主导社会制度框架之间的不匹配和再匹配。再匹配的解释通常与先前社会限制的崩溃联系在一起，因为占主导地位的制度无法在关键因素和载体部门推动资本积累，因此无法促进新的技术经济范式的扩展。本文建议重新评估这一观点，探讨一项新技术——超通信和社交媒体——如何重塑权力关系，伴随着技术寡头的出现。我们得出结论，这是一个技术通过适应塑造先前社会框架并通过创造新的制度和文化导致深刻转变的案例，包括人类主体地位的转变。

papers.title_en: Behind the curve: econometric estimation and sectoral decomposition of the Japanese Beveridge curve’s evolution around the COVID-19 pandemic
papers.title_zh: 疫情背景下的日本贝弗里奇曲线演变：计量经济估计与行业分解
papers.abstract_en: Abstract This paper examines the Japanese Beveridge curve in order to identify a possible structural break prior to the COVID-19 pandemic and uncover its potential causes. We utilize two levels of analysis. First, the relationship for the period January 2000–June 2024 is estimated by means of a vector error correction model, through which we detect a structural break at the end of 2019. Second, we use disaggregated vacancy and unemployment data to analyze the Beveridge curves for subgroups at the occupational, industrial, and contractual levels and carry out an extensive mismatch analysis. We argue that the asymmetric evolution of the different segments of the market, together with tight market conditions, is at the root of the modification in the responsiveness of vacancies to unemployment recorded from the end of 2019. More specifically, the change originated in the services-related sector, which recorded extremely tight market conditions since 2018, leading firms to reduce vacancies without any significant impact on the sector-level unemployment rate. This trend was subsequently compounded by the measures introduced by the government in 2020 in order to support employment during the COVID-19 pandemic.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文考察了日本的贝弗里奇曲线，以识别COVID-19大流行前可能存在的结构性断裂，并揭示其潜在原因。我们采用两个层面的分析。首先，通过向量误差修正模型估计了2000年1月至2024年6月期间的关系，我们发现2019年底出现了结构性断裂。其次，我们使用分行业的空缺和失业数据，分析了职业、行业和合同层面的贝弗里奇曲线，并进行了广泛的错配分析。我们认为，市场不同部分的不对称演变，以及市场紧缩状况，是2019年底记录的空缺对失业反应性变化的根本原因。更具体地说，变化起源于与服务业相关的部门，该部门自2018年以来市场状况极为紧张，导致企业减少空缺，而对部门层面的失业率没有显著影响。随后，这一趋势因2020年政府为支持COVID-19大流行期间的就业而采取的措施而加剧。

papers.title_en: Stable profit rates in a time of rising market power: the role of financial and intangible assets in the US corporate sector
papers.title_zh: 标题：市场力量上升时期的稳定利润率：金融和无形资产在美国企业部门的作用
papers.abstract_en: Abstract While the aggregate profit margin (profits to sales) rises almost 50% after 1980, the profit rate (profits to assets) is steady. We reconcile these two pictures of profitability by showing that firms’ sales per dollar of assets fall after 1980, reflecting growth in financial and intangible assets. This result suggests that firms receive lower sales on financial and intangible assets than on fixed capital, and links these asset holdings to competitive strategies that consolidate market power while also inflating asset values.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要：尽管1980年后总体利润率（利润对销售额）上升了近50%，但利润率（利润对资产）保持稳定。我们通过展示1980年后公司每美元资产的销售额下降，反映了金融和无形资产的增长，来协调这两种盈利能力的表现。这一结果表明，公司在金融和无形资产上的销售额低于固定资产，并把这些资产持有与巩固市场力量的竞争策略联系起来，同时也推高了资产价值。

papers.title_en: Back to fiscal rules: The insanity of normality, unless the rich pay for it!
papers.title_zh: 重返财政规则：除非富人买单，否则正常即疯狂！
papers.abstract_en: Abstract With central banks and national governments returning to more conservative monetary and fiscal policies after Covid, the debate about the macroeconomic effects of fiscal rules has revamped. We address this topic via an extended version of the hybrid ABM-SFC model in Botta et al. (2024) that includes a Taylor-type monetary policy rule and a variety of fiscal rules aimed at reducing the public debt-to-GDP ratio. We compare spending-based fiscal rules vastly advocated by international economic institutions with wealth tax-based fiscal policies. We do this in the context of a modern financialized economy where securitization and complex financial products like Asset-Backed Securities (ABS) alter economic dynamics and the effectiveness of monetary policy in controlling inflation. We assume heterogeneous households to track how alternative fiscal strategies affect income and wealth inequality. Our findings are threefold. First, spending-based fiscal rules can reduce the debt-to-GDP ratio in the long term but at the cost of significantly higher unemployment and permanently lower real GDP. Second, wealth tax-based fiscal policies reduce public debt without harming economic performance. Third, perhaps unexpectedly, in a financialized economy, spending-based fiscal austerity may hurt the relative position of rich households in wealth distribution as much as a wealth tax does; this is due to capital losses that spending cuts may eventually induce in households’ financial wealth. In the end, wealth taxes are preferable to spending cuts, and the usual political opposition against them by the rich appears largely unfounded given their potential economic benefits compared to spending-based fiscal austerity.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要：在新冠疫情后，各国央行和政府回归更为保守的货币和财政政策，关于财政规则宏观经济效应的讨论再次升温。我们通过扩展Botta等人（2024年）提出的混合ABM-SFC模型来探讨这一主题，该模型包含了泰勒型货币政策规则和旨在降低公共债务与GDP比率的多种财政规则。我们将国际经济机构大力倡导的基于支出的财政规则与基于财富税的财政政策进行比较。这种比较是在现代金融化经济背景下进行的，其中证券化和复杂的金融产品如资产支持证券（ABS）改变了经济动态和货币政策控制通胀的有效性。我们假设家庭异质性，以追踪不同财政策略如何影响收入和财富不平等。我们的发现有三个方面。首先，基于支出的财政规则可以在长期内降低债务与GDP比率，但代价是显著更高的失业率和永久性降低的实际GDP。其次，基于财富税的财政政策可以在不损害经济表现的情况下减少公共债务。第三，或许出人意料的是，在金融化经济中，基于支出的财政紧缩可能与财富税一样损害富裕家庭在财富分配中的相对地位；这是由于支出削减可能最终在家庭金融财富中引起的资本损失。最终，财富税比支出削减更可取，富裕阶层对它们的政治反对在很大程度上是没有根据的，考虑到它们与基于支出的财政紧缩相比的潜在经济利益。

papers.title_en: Growth, inequality, and declining business dynamism in a unified Schumpeter Mark I + II model
papers.title_zh: 标题：统一的熊彼特I+II模型中的增长、不平等和企业活力下降
papers.abstract_en: Abstract I develop a Schumpeterian agent-based model in which the entry and exit of firms, their productivity and markup, the birth of new industries, and the social structure of the population are endogenous. I use this model to study the causes of rising inequality and declining “business dynamism” since the 1980s. My hybrid model combines features of (i) the so-called Schumpeter Mark I (centering around the entrepreneur), (ii) the Mark II model (emphasizing the innovative capacities of firms), and (iii) Cournot competition, with firms using ordinary least squares learning to estimate the market environment and the behavior of their competitors. A scenario that is quantitatively calibrated to US data on growth and inequality replicates a large number of stylized facts regarding the industry life cycle, growth, inequality, and all 10 stylized facts on “declining business dynamism” in the USA proposed by Akcigit and Ates (2021, AEJ: Macroeconomics, 13[1], 257–298). Counterfactual simulations show that antitrust policy is highly effective at combatting inequality and at increasing business dynamism and growth but is subject to a conflict of interest between workers and firm owners, as gross domestic product and wages grow at the expense of profits. I further explore how technological factors interact with “Mark I” and “Mark II” in my model to shape dynamics of growth, inequality, and business dynamism.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要：我构建了一个基于施瓦茨曼的代理模型，其中企业的进入和退出、它们的生产率和加成、新产业的诞生以及人口的社会结构都是内生的。我使用这个模型来研究自20世纪80年代以来不平等上升和“商业活力”下降的原因。我的混合模型结合了（i）所谓的施瓦茨曼马克I（以企业家为中心）、（ii）马克II模型（强调企业的创新能力）和（iii）库诺竞争的特点，企业使用普通最小二乘学习来估计市场环境和竞争对手的行为。一个定量校准到美国增长和不平等数据的情景复制了大量关于行业生命周期、增长、不平等以及阿克西吉特和阿特斯（2021年，《美国经济杂志：宏观经济学》，13[1]，257-298）提出的美国“商业活力下降”的所有10个典型事实。反事实模拟表明，反垄断政策在打击不平等和增加商业活力和增长方面非常有效，但受到工人和企业主利益冲突的影响，因为国内生产总值和工资的增长是以牺牲利润为代价的。我进一步探讨了技术因素如何与我的模型中的“马克I”和“马克II”相互作用，以塑造增长、不平等和商业活力的动态。

papers.title_en: The value of a park in crises: Quantifying the health and wellbeing benefits of green spaces using exogenous variations in use values
papers.title_zh: 危机中的公园价值：利用使用价值的外生变化量化绿地的健康与福祉效益
papers.abstract_en: Most people consider parks important for their quality of life, yet systematic causal evidence is missing. We exploit exogenous variations in their use values to estimate causal effects. Using a representative household panel with precise geographical coordinates of households linked to satellite images of green spaces with a nationwide coverage, we employ a spatial difference-in-differences design, comparing within-individual changes between residents living close to a green space with those living further away. We exploit Covid-19 as an exogenous shock. We find that green spaces raised overall life satisfaction while reducing symptoms of anxiety (feelings of nervousness and worry) and depression. There is also suggestive evidence for reduced loneliness. Given the number of people in their surroundings, a compensating-surplus calculation suggests that parks added substantial benefits during the period studied.
papers.abstract_zh: 大多数人认为公园对他们的生活质量很重要，但缺乏系统的因果证据。我们利用其使用价值的外生变化来估计因果效应。我们使用一个具有代表性的家庭面板，将家庭的精确地理坐标与全国覆盖的绿地卫星图像联系起来，采用空间差异-差异设计，比较居住在绿地附近的居民与居住在更远地方的居民之间的个体内部变化。我们利用Covid-19作为外生冲击。我们发现，绿地提高了整体生活满意度，同时减少了焦虑（紧张和担忧的感觉）和抑郁症状。还有迹象表明孤独感有所减少。考虑到他们周围人数，补偿剩余计算表明，在研究期间，公园增加了大量好处。

papers.title_en: Strategic Delay and Bargaining Over Public Insurance Coverage for Drugs in Australia
papers.title_zh: 澳大利亚药品公共保险覆盖的战略延迟与谈判
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Public funding for pharmaceuticals often follows repeated negotiation between manufacturers and a public agency, yet little empirical work examines how the timing of agreement reflects the economic structure of these interactions. Using a duration model of negotiations in Australia from 2005 to 2018, we assess whether observed patterns of delay and agreement align with dynamic bargaining theory under incomplete information. Agreements from 634 submissions for 400 therapies required a median of 16 months, and 71% of negotiation rounds ended without agreement. Therapies with lower expected value to the agency—reflected in higher incremental cost per QALY, greater budget impact, or evidence uncertainty—experienced longer delays and lower agreement rates, while those with strong clinical importance, perceived need, or elevated public interest were listed more quickly. Delays also varied across therapeutic classes and with a therapy's position in the sequencing of available treatments. The observed patterns point to a systematic listing rule in which therapies are funded when expected health gains justify their opportunity costs. They also support the view that the timing of agreement reflects strategic negotiation under uncertainty, not simply procedural delay.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 药品公共资金通常遵循制造商和公共机构之间的重复谈判，但很少有实证研究检验协议达成时间如何反映这些互动的经济结构。利用2005至2018年澳大利亚谈判的持续时间模型，我们评估观察到的延迟和协议模式是否与不完全信息下的动态博弈理论一致。634项提交涉及400种疗法的协议需要中位数16个月，71%的谈判轮次以未达成协议结束。对机构预期价值较低的疗法——反映在更高的每QALY增量成本、更大的预算影响或证据不确定性——经历了更长的延迟和更低的协议率，而那些具有强烈临床重要性、感知需求或提高公共利益的疗法则更快地被列入。延迟还因治疗类别和疗法在可用治疗序列中的位置而异。观察到的模式指向一个系统性的上市规则，即当预期健康收益证明其机会成本合理时，才会资助疗法。它们也支持这样一种观点，即协议达成的时间反映了在不确定性下的战略性谈判，而不仅仅是程序性延迟。

papers.title_en: Gambling and Substance Use: Early Evidence From Sports Betting Laws
papers.title_zh: 赌博与物质使用：体育博彩法律的早期证据
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Previous research documents a strong association between gambling and substance use, suggesting that these seemingly distinct behaviors may share similar environmental, neurobiological, and genetic causes. However, there is a dearth of credible empirical evidence on whether gambling has a causal impact on substance use or vice versa. This paper estimates the impact of gambling on substance use making use of the rapid roll‐out of sports betting laws across US states. Using data from the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System and a difference‐in‐difference (DID) estimation strategy to assess the impact of legalizing sports betting on smoking and drinking behavior among adults, we find that the legalization of online sports betting has increased binge drinking frequency‐at the intensive margin among young men by approximately 10 percent, but find no discernible impact on smoking. The results are consistent across traditional two‐way fixed effects models as well as more recently developed DID methods designed for staggered treatment adoption.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 先前的研究记录了赌博和物质使用之间存在强烈的关联，表明这些看似不同的行为可能共享相似的环境、神经生物学和遗传原因。然而，关于赌博是否对物质使用有因果影响，或者反之亦然，缺乏可信的实证证据。本文利用美国各州体育博彩法律的快速推出，估计赌博对物质使用的影响。使用来自行为风险因素监测系统的数据，并采用双重差分（DID）估计策略，评估合法化体育博彩对成年人吸烟和饮酒行为的影响，我们发现在线体育博彩的合法化在年轻男性中增加了大约10%的暴饮频率，但在吸烟方面没有发现明显影响。这些结果在传统的双向固定效应模型以及最近为分阶段治疗采用而开发的DID方法中是一致的。

papers.title_en: Information Shocks, Legal Liability and Physician Decisions
papers.title_zh: 信息冲击、法律责任与医生决策
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Physician adoption of new information about a medical procedure can affect patient outcomes. Medical malpractice law may influence physician use of such information. We analyze how physician reactions to information shocks regarding vaginal births after cesarean sections (VBACs) in the 1990s were mediated by tort reform and the standard used in malpractice claims to determine a physician's duty of care to patients. Differentiating states according to whether they capped non‐economic damages in malpractice claims (Caps) and whether they defined the duty of care using a national or a local reference point, we analyze how physicians under the four legal regimes reacted to a series of adverse information shocks regarding VBACs over the period. Our results suggest that physicians whose duty of care is determined by standard practices nationwide are less likely to adopt innovations which have not yet been incorporated into those practices and more likely to adopt innovations once they are incorporated into those practices. Caps may moderate these effects. Our results also suggest intuitive heterogeneity in the effects of legal regime on physician decisions.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要：医生对有关医疗程序的新信息的采纳可能会影响患者的治疗结果。医疗事故法律可能会影响医生使用这些信息。我们分析了医生对1990年代关于剖宫产后阴道分娩（VBACs）的信息冲击的反应是如何通过医疗事故改革和确定医生对患者护理责任的标准来调节的。根据各州是否限制医疗事故索赔中的非经济损害赔偿（上限）以及是否使用全国或地方参考点来定义护理责任，我们分析了在四种法律制度下，医生对VBACs一系列不利信息冲击的反应。我们的研究结果表明，那些护理责任由全国标准实践确定的医生不太可能采纳尚未纳入这些实践的创新，而一旦这些创新被纳入这些实践，他们更有可能采纳这些创新。上限可能会调节这些效应。我们的结果还表明，法律制度对医生决策的影响存在直观的异质性。

papers.title_en: Are Health Gains to Children and Adolescents More Important Than Health Gains to Adults? A Person Trade-Off Study
papers.title_zh: 儿童和青少年的健康收益是否比成年人更重要？一项个体权衡研究
papers.abstract_en: PURPOSE: Healthcare decision-making often assumes equal value for quality-adjusted life years (QALYs) across patient groups, yet societal preferences suggest that the value of a QALY may vary with characteristics such as age. Evidence indicates some willingness to prioritise child health gains, though findings are inconsistent. This study used person trade-off (PTO) to estimate the relative social value of different types of health gains for children and adolescents (aged 0-24 years) compared with adults. METHODS: A representative Australian sample aged 16 years and above (n = 2098) completed an online survey comparing life extension and quality-of-life improvements for different ages. A 'chaining' approach tested response consistency, and logistic regression explored associations between PTO choices and respondent characteristics. Attitudinal questions and open text responses provided additional insights. RESULTS: PTO responses show that health gains for children and adolescents (4-24 years) are generally valued more highly than those for adults (age 40 or 55 years), with weights ranging from 1 to 1.3. For very young children, findings vary by health gain type: life extensions for infants (1 month or 2 years) are weighted lower, but pain alleviation is higher (weights ≥ 1.2). Qualitative and attitudinal data reveal diverse views, with many opposing age-weighting. Younger respondents and those with young children prioritise children more, while older and female participants preferred equal treatment. CONCLUSIONS: The relative value of child QALY gains varies by age of the child, by health gain type, and by adult comparison age. While alleviating children's pain is strongly supported (weights ≥ 1.2), overall views are polarised, highlighting the complexity of age-based prioritisation.
papers.abstract_zh: 目的：医疗决策通常假设不同患者群体的质量调整生命年（QALYs）具有相等价值，然而社会偏好表明QALY的价值可能随年龄等特征而变化。证据显示，人们愿意优先考虑儿童健康收益，但发现结果并不一致。本研究使用个体权衡（PTO）方法估计儿童和青少年（0-24岁）与成人相比不同类型的健康收益的相对社会价值。方法：一个具有代表性的澳大利亚样本，年龄在16岁及以上（n=2098）完成了一个在线调查，比较了不同年龄段的生命延长和生活质量改善。“链接”方法测试了响应的一致性，逻辑回归探索了PTO选择与受访者特征之间的关联。态度问题和开放式文本回应提供了额外的见解。结果：PTO回应显示，儿童和青少年（4-24岁）的健康收益通常比成人（40岁或55岁）更受重视，权重范围从1到1.3。对于非常年幼的儿童，结果因健康收益类型而异：婴儿的生命延长（1个月或2年）的权重较低，但疼痛缓解的权重更高（权重≥1.2）。定性和态度数据揭示了多样化的观点，许多人反对年龄加权。年轻的受访者和有小孩的人更倾向于优先考虑儿童，而年长和女性参与者更倾向于平等对待。结论：儿童QALY收益的相对价值因儿童年龄、健康收益类型和成人比较年龄而异。虽然缓解儿童疼痛得到了强烈支持（权重≥1.2），但总体观点是两极分化的，突出了基于年龄的优先排序的复杂性。

papers.title_en: Estimating the Value of Combination Vaccines: A Methodological Framework
papers.title_zh: 估算联合疫苗价值：一个方法论框架
papers.abstract_en: Combination vaccines combine several components in a single dose administration. They offer programmatic and public health advantages, particularly as vaccine schedules become increasingly crowded. They are often more expensive to develop and produce, which discourages manufacturer investment without clear market signals. Hence their benefits need to be captured with existing health economic evaluation reference cases used by decision-makers to guide vaccine investments. We propose that the value of combination vaccines can be captured through at least four domains: (1) reductions in tangible and intangible costs to caregivers, (2) operational efficiencies to the health system, (3) opportunity costs of vaccine schedule slots, and (4) more streamlined vaccine schedules. We demonstrate the practicality of our framework by comparing the value of introducing a hypothetical vaccine to a crowded schedule as a standalone formulation, a replacement for a vaccine already in the schedule, or a combination product. The framework could also be applied to estimate the value of reducing the number of separate administrations needed for a standalone vaccine. Applying it in real-world situations could be facilitated by further data collection, particularly on collating results on the value of existing vaccines in the schedule and estimating willingness-to-pay for fewer vaccine administrations.
papers.abstract_zh: 联合疫苗将多个组分合并为单剂量给药。随着疫苗接种计划日益拥挤，它们提供了计划性和公共卫生优势。它们的开发和生产成本通常更高，这在没有明确的市场信号的情况下阻碍了制造商的投资。因此，需要通过决策者使用的现有健康经济评估参考案例来捕捉联合疫苗的好处，以指导疫苗投资。我们建议，可以通过至少四个领域捕捉联合疫苗的价值：（1）减少护理人员的有形和无形成本，（2）提高卫生系统的运营效率，（3）疫苗接种计划插槽的机会成本，以及（4）更简化的疫苗接种计划。我们通过比较将假设疫苗引入拥挤计划作为单独配方、替换计划中已有疫苗或组合产品的价值，展示了我们框架的实用性。该框架还可以用来估计减少单独疫苗所需的单独给药次数的价值。通过进一步收集数据，尤其是在整理计划中现有疫苗的价值结果和估计减少疫苗给药次数的支付意愿方面，可以促进其在现实世界情况中的应用。

papers.title_en: Innovative Contracting for Gene Therapies: Current Landscape and Perspectives on the Future of Gene Therapy Financing in the USA
papers.title_zh: 基因疗法的创新合同：美国基因疗法融资现状及未来展望
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVE: Over the last decade, payers in the USA have been exploring novel financing mechanisms for gene therapies (GTs). Our research objective was to assess the landscape of innovative contracts (ICs) between payers and manufacturers for GTs and identify barriers and opportunities for future contract development and implementation. METHODS: We used a multi-method approach including a targeted literature review and interviews. We developed a framework defining 'innovative contracts' as agreements using real-world outcomes that link to the total price paid for gene therapy, encompassing value-based pricing, outcome-based payments, and performance-based models between payers and manufacturers. We searched for published information about implementation of ICs for GTs in PubMed and government, industry, and research institutions from January 2014 to January 2025. We excluded any insights specific to ICs for non-GTs as well as those relevant to ex-US markets. We supplemented these findings with bibliographic searches. Semi-structured interviews with payers, manufacturers, and other diverse representatives from the GT financing ecosystem were conducted to validate and enrich the literature findings. RESULTS: The PubMed search yielded ten studies relevant to implementation of ICs. Gray literature included over 50 publications referencing active contracts, policy solutions, payer budget impact, and state Medicaid programs' innovative GT contracting. Information on manufacturer and payer contracts was publicly available for 10 of 14 gene therapies (71%). Of 16 identified GT contracts, eight used upfront payments with milestone-based rebates, two used performance-based installment payments, one offered upfront payment with a rebate or payment over 5 years, and five do not have publicly available details on the type of financial arrangement. Interviews (N = 15) suggested that barriers to ICs include a lack of mutual trust between payers and manufacturers, lack of data conveying the return on investment for innovative contracts, lack of a sufficient incentive for stakeholders to engage in contracting, perceived regulatory limitations (e.g., implications of Medicaid Best Price), and patient portability challenges. Some interviewees believed that ICs should be the standard for GTs, while others stated that ICs should only be pursued when they are expected to have a significant impact on timely patient access in the early launch period when payers are considering limited or no coverage. Interviewees indicated that policy changes may encourage future contracting negotiation and implementation. CONCLUSIONS: Widespread uptake of ICs will require a multi-stakeholder collaboration to overcome common barriers, as a one-size-fits-all approach is insufficient for diverse stakeholder needs. Establishing industry-wide contracting principles and practices may help bridge differences in opinions and build trust between contracting parties, allow stakeholders to share lessons from early adopters, and support efficient contracting processes that promote consistent and equitable patient access to GTs while ensuring healthcare system sustainability.

papers.title_en: Patient-Level Health Economic Modeling in Excel Without VBA: A Tutorial

Their limited ability to capture patient-level characteristics can, in the presence of patient heterogeneity or the need to track patient characteristics to accurately capture a technology's implications, introduce bias. Their continued prevalence is explained by key stakeholders' familiarity with spreadsheet software, and the lower computational burden of cohort-level versus patient-level models. However, contemporary Excel functions have opened up possibilities for calculations within native Excel that enable more flexible, patient-level approaches to be implemented in familiar spreadsheet-based software, without use of any Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) code. papers.abstract_zh: 尽管有呼声和理由要求采用更灵活的方法，但成本效益模型仍然是指导健康技术评估（HTA）的标准，因为它们在捕捉患者个体特征方面的能力有限，这可能会在患者异质性存在或需要追踪患者特征以准确捕捉技术影响的情况下引入偏差。它们之所以持续流行，是因为关键利益相关者对电子表格软件的熟悉，以及队列级模型相对于个体级模型的计算负担较低。然而，现代Excel功能为在原生Excel中进行计算提供了可能性，使得在熟悉的基于电子表格的软件中实现更灵活的个体级方法成为可能，而无需使用任何Visual Basic for Applications（VBA）代码。因此，本教程旨在提供分步指导，说明如何在Excel中使用现代Excel功能且不使用任何VBA代码来实现先前发表且免费提供的个体级离散事件模拟（DES）。

papers.title_en: Face Validation of an Artificial Intelligence Driven Tool for Clinical Triaging in Australian Public Oral Healthcare: A Pilot Study
papers.title_zh: 澳大利亚公共口腔医疗临床分流中人工智能驱动工具的人脸验证：一项试点研究
papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVES: The adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) technology holds significant potential to drive innovation for value-based healthcare for Victorian public oral healthcare, Australia. This pilot study compared the clinical triage decision outcome of experienced dentists in prioritizing consumers with urgent dental care at Your Community Health, a community health service in Victoria, Australia, with those generated by the CoTreat AI-driven tool (CoTreat Pty Ltd, Australia). METHODS: Consecutive sampling of consumers were recruited for the 6-month pilot. Five clinical criteria were established to determine consumers with urgent care: (1) requires urgent extraction causing loss of upper or lower anterior teeth, (2) multiple teeth (≥15% of remaining dentition) with moderate/extensive dental caries, (3) abscessed tooth/teeth, (4) root caries, and (5) missing upper and lower anterior teeth. Face validation was undertaken to compare the agreement between the triage output returned by CoTreat (index test) and 2 experienced dentists (reference standard) in determining urgent care. RESULTS: A total of 173 consumers were triaged in this pilot study (mean age 61.9 years [SD 18.]). One-third (n = 57) were identified needing urgent care. CoTreat achieved 98.3% agreement with dentist clinical triage outcome (Cohen's k = 0.96), 100% sensitivity, and 97.5% specificity, with positive predictive value of 94.7% and negative predictive value of 100%. The most common triage criteria were missing anterior teeth (60.3%) and abscesses (20.7%). CONCLUSIONS: CoTreat demonstrated excellent agreement with dentists' clinical triage decisions. AI-driven tools, such as CoTreat, can advance value-based healthcare implementation by identifying consumers with urgent care needs for Victorian public oral healthcare.
papers.abstract_zh: 目标：采用人工智能（AI）技术对于推动澳大利亚维多利亚州公共口腔保健的价值基础医疗创新具有重大潜力。本试点研究比较了在维多利亚州澳大利亚社区健康服务Your Community Health中，经验丰富的牙医在优先考虑急需牙科护理的消费者时的临床分诊决策结果，与CoTreat AI驱动工具（CoTreat Pty Ltd，澳大利亚）生成的结果。方法：连续抽样的消费者被招募参加为期6个月的试点。建立了五个临床标准来确定急需护理的消费者：（1）需要紧急拔牙导致上颌或下颌前牙缺失，（2）多颗牙齿（≥15%的剩余牙齿）中度/广泛龋齿，（3）脓肿牙齿/牙齿，（4）根龋，以及（5）缺失上颌和下颌前牙。进行面部验证，比较CoTreat（指数测试）返回的分诊输出与2位经验丰富的牙医（参考标准）在确定紧急护理时的一致性。结果：本试点研究共对173名消费者进行了分诊（平均年龄61.9岁[SD 18]）。三分之一（n = 57）被确定需要紧急护理。CoTreat与牙医临床分诊结果的一致性达到98.3%（Cohen's k = 0.96），敏感性100%，特异性97.5%，阳性预测值为94.7%，阴性预测值为100%。最常见的分诊标准是缺失前牙（60.3%）和脓肿（20.7%）。结论：CoTreat与牙医的临床分诊决策显示出极佳的一致性。像CoTreat这样的AI驱动工具，可以通过识别维多利亚州公共口腔保健中急需护理的消费者，推进价值基础医疗的实施。

METHODS: eq; scenario analysis up to €0.21/kg) and added to costs. Despite higher emissions, RPM remained cost-saving (€102 per patient) with a positive incremental net monetary benefit (€42); only 1% of cost difference was attributable to emissions. papers.abstract_zh: 目的：研究如何应用两种方法论途径将环境结果纳入心脏手术后远程患者监测（RPM）与常规护理（UC）的卫生技术评估中。方法：在成本效益分析中，计算了RPM与UC之间的成本差异（每公斤0.21欧元）并加到成本中。在多标准决策分析（MCDA）中，使用分析层次过程评估了包括环境影响在内的6个标准，并使用利益相关者估值。结果：RPM的每患者等效成本较低，主要由设备生产驱动，部分被减少的非计划护理、门诊访问和患者旅行所抵消。尽管排放量更高，RPM仍然是节省成本的（每患者102欧元），具有正的增量净货币效益（42欧元）；成本差异中只有1%归因于排放。在MCDA中，RPM在6个标准中的5个标准上优于UC，UC仅在环境影响上受到青睐。利益相关者对环境标准赋予了适度的权重，导致RPM的整体价值得分更高（0.649对0.351）。结论：两种方法都是可行的，尽管RPM的碳排放量更高，但得出了相同的结论。在当前的碳价格下，经济评估影响很小，而MCDA允许明确的可持续性考虑，但对主观选择敏感。总体而言，环境结果可能更好地通过审议性的卫生技术评估流程来解决，更广泛的政策工具是减少医疗保健碳排放的关键。

papers.title_en: Estimating the Shares of the Value of Branded Pharmaceuticals Accruing to Manufacturers and to Patients in the Thai Healthcare System
papers.title_zh: 泰国医疗系统中品牌药品价值在制造商和患者之间的分配份额估算
papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVES: This article aims to inform which pricing policies for new pharmaceuticals will benefit population health most, and which will not, by drawing out the implications of current pricing policy in Thailand for the value that new, branded pharmaceuticals bring to the population. METHODS: We quantify the lifecycle value in terms of net population health gains of 9 new, branded pharmaceutical and indication combinations by evaluating lifetime health gains and reimbursement costs, considering the availability of generics or biosimilars. We then analyze how the value is shared between the population and manufacturers. RESULTS: Two-thirds of the pharmaceutical and indication combinations generated net population health gains over their lifecycle, with more than 90% of the total potential net health effects benefiting patients within the Thai healthcare system. However, manufacturers received a low proportion of value. Key factors driving these outcomes included delayed adoption of new pharmaceuticals and entry of generics or biosimilars. Conversely, 2 pharmaceuticals that were approved despite being deemed cost-ineffective resulted in net losses to population health. CONCLUSIONS: Quantification of the lifecycle value of new pharmaceuticals can better inform policies that enhance population health. In Thailand, policies that could improve overall population health include earlier adoption of new pharmaceuticals alongside careful price regulation and expedited generic entry. These approaches could also provide mechanisms to signal research and development priorities effectively.
papers.abstract_zh: 目的：本文旨在通过分析泰国当前药品定价政策对新品牌药品为人群健康带来的价值的影响，来告知哪些新药品的定价政策最有利于人群健康，哪些则不然。方法：我们通过评估9种新品牌药品及其适应症组合的终身健康增益和报销成本，量化了其生命周期价值，并考虑了仿制药或生物类似药的可用性。然后分析了价值如何在人群和制造商之间共享。结果：三分之二的药品和适应症组合在其生命周期内产生了净人群健康增益，超过90%的总潜在净健康效应使泰国医疗保健系统内的患者受益。然而，制造商获得的价值比例较低。导致这些结果的关键因素包括新药品的采用延迟以及仿制药或生物类似药的进入。相反，尽管被认为成本效益不高，但有2种药品获批导致人群健康净损失。结论：量化新药品的生命周期价值可以更好地为提高人群健康的政策提供信息。在泰国，可以改善整体人群健康的政策包括尽早采用新药品，同时谨慎进行价格调控和加快仿制药的进入。这些方法还可以提供有效信号研发优先事项的机制。

papers.title_en: The Effect of Perspective, Duration, and Views on Death on the Valuation of Severe Health States
papers.title_zh: 视角、持续时间和死亡观对严重健康状况评估的影响
papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVES: Composite time trade-off utilities typically vary by perspective: adults tend to assign lower utilities to health states for themselves (self-perspective) than for children (proxy-perspective). Utilities also differ between proxy-perspectives: i.e., deciding for a child (proxy1) vs imagining what a child wants (proxy2). This can cause health states to be evaluated as better than dead (BTD) under one perspective, yet worse than dead (WTD) under another. We investigate how such WTD preferences vary with health states across durations and perspectives, alongside sociocultural factors such as religion and attitudes toward death. As a secondary analysis, we explore the maximal endurable time hypothesis to assess the consistency of WTD preferences. METHODS: We surveyed 1000 UK respondents, stratified into 2 groups by religious affiliation (religious vs nonreligious). Each completed BTD tasks from a self-perspective and a randomly assigned proxy perspective (proxy1 or proxy2), involving 5 health states across 4 durations. Respondents also ranked all health states (without duration) and immediate death. RESULTS: In ranking tasks without duration, WTD preferences were unaffected by perspective or religious affiliation, whereas the proportion of states considered WTD increased with longer durations in paired comparisons in the BTD tasks among nonreligious participants. WTD preferences were associated with stronger support for euthanasia and lower religiousness. Maximal endurable time preferences showed minimal differences across perspectives or religious affiliations. CONCLUSIONS: Perspectives, duration, religious affiliation, and views on euthanasia shape WTD preferences. Future research is encouraged to consider religion in sampling and how to deal with the potential duration dependency of QALY-anchored utilities.
papers.abstract_zh: 目标：复合时间权衡效用通常因视角而异：成人倾向于为自己（自我视角）分配较低的健康状态效用，而为儿童（代理视角）分配较高的效用。代理视角之间也存在效用差异，即，为儿童做决定（代理1）与想象儿童想要什么（代理2）之间的区别。这可能导致某些健康状态在一种视角下被评估为比死亡更好（BTD），而在另一种视角下则被评估为比死亡更差（WTD）。我们研究了这种WTD偏好如何随着健康状态、持续时间以及视角的变化而变化，同时考虑了社会文化因素，如宗教和对死亡的态度。作为次要分析，我们探讨了最大可忍受时间假设，以评估WTD偏好的一致性。方法：我们调查了1000名英国受访者，按宗教信仰分为两组（宗教与非宗教）。每个人从自我视角和随机分配的代理视角（代理1或代理2）完成BTD任务，涉及5种健康状态和4个持续时间。受访者还对所有健康状态（不考虑持续时间）和立即死亡进行了排名。结果：在不考虑持续时间的排名任务中，WTD偏好不受视角或宗教信仰的影响，而在非宗教参与者中，随着BTD任务中持续时间的延长，被认为是WTD状态的比例在配对比较中增加。WTD偏好与对安乐死的更强支持和较低的宗教性相关。最大可忍受时间偏好在视角或宗教信仰之间显示出最小的差异。结论：视角、持续时间、宗教信仰和对安乐死的看法塑造了WTD偏好。鼓励未来的研究考虑抽样中的宗教因素，以及如何处理与QALY锚定效用潜在的持续时间依赖性。

papers.title_en: Qini Curves for Potential Impact Assessment of Risk Predictive Models Informing Intervention Policies
papers.title_zh: 秦尼曲线：评估风险预测模型对干预政策潜在影响
papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVES: Predictive models in medicine help make decisions about which individual to treat with a given therapeutic or preventive intervention. Before being tested in large field studies and recommended for clinical adoption, it is important to evaluate not only their statistical accuracy but also the impact they may have when used to inform health intervention policies. We aim to provide simple methods for the potential impact assessment of health intervention policies based on predictive models. METHODS: We propose an analytic framework based on Qini curves wherein prediction-based policies are analyzed on 2 impact endpoints: (1) the fraction of the population that would be selected for the intervention (coverage) and (2) the effect on the clinical outcomes of interest (disutility). The drivers of values are the disease prevalence, the predictive performance of the model, and the effectiveness of the intervention. RESULTS: We present simple formulas for calculating coverage and disutility from either observational or randomized controlled data. We illustrate possible value measures arising from geometrical properties on the Qini plane: delta coverage and disutility, number needed to treat, and integrated difference between Qini curves. We show the applicability of the Qini analysis by providing examples about the prevention of falls in older adults and prevention of secondary cardiovascular events with pioglitazone. CONCLUSIONS: Coverage and disutility capture key value components of prediction-based policies. The method can be used for comparing models or tuning risk thresholds for managing trade-offs between conflicting objectives (eg, clinical benefits, side effects, and healthcare resources).
papers.abstract_zh: 目标：医学中的预测模型有助于决定对哪些个体使用特定的治疗或预防干预措施。在进行大规模现场研究和推荐临床应用之前，评估这些模型不仅需要考虑它们的统计准确性，还需要评估它们在用于指导健康干预政策时可能产生的影响。我们旨在提供基于预测模型的健康干预政策潜在影响评估的简单方法。方法：我们提出了一个基于Qini曲线的分析框架，在此框架中，基于预测的政策在两个影响终点上进行分析：（1）将被选为干预对象的人口比例（覆盖率）和（2）对感兴趣的临床结果的影响（无用性）。这些值的驱动因素是疾病流行率、模型的预测性能和干预措施的有效性。结果：我们提出了从观察性或随机对照数据中计算覆盖率和无用性的简单公式。我们通过Qini平面上的几何属性说明了可能出现的价值度量：覆盖率和无用性的差异、需要治疗的人数，以及Qini曲线之间的综合差异。我们通过提供关于预防老年人跌倒和使用吡格列酮预防心血管次级事件的例子来展示Qini分析的适用性。结论：覆盖率和无用性捕捉了基于预测的政策的关键价值组成部分。该方法可用于比较模型或调整风险阈值，以管理相互冲突的目标之间的权衡（例如，临床效益、副作用和医疗资源）。

papers.title_en: From Consensus to Implementation: Advancing Patient-Centered Health Technology Assessment
papers.title_zh: 从共识到实施：推进以患者为中心的健康技术评估

papers.title_en: Toward a Harmonized Health Technology Assessment Framework for Digital Health Technologies in Europe
papers.title_zh: 迈向欧洲数字健康技术统一健康技术评估框架
papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVES: The increasing use of digital health technologies (DHTs) in Europe presents opportunities and challenges. Although DHTs could enhance care delivery and health outcomes, existing health technology assessment (HTA) methods often lack flexibility to address their diverse, fast-evolving nature. This article explores the perspectives of 5 stakeholder groups-policy makers, HTA agencies, technology developers, healthcare providers, and patients-regarding the development of a harmonized HTA framework for DHTs within the Horizon Europe funded European Digital Health Technology Assessment (EDiHTA) project. METHODS: Findings are drawn from mixed-method research, including stakeholder surveys, interviews and focus groups with 97 stakeholders across European countries. The analysis of the data was performed per each stakeholder group through thematic analysis to identify points of consensus before identifying needs and requirements across stakeholders, relevant to the development of EDiHTA, using the Innovation Health Technology Assessment Methods framework. RESULTS: Results from 8 focus groups and more than 45 interviews are presented concentrating on 5 main themes. The emerging themes focus on the need for harmonization of HTA methods related to DHTs, the current characteristics of DHTs that are most highly valued, the importance of multistakeholder collaboration, the principles of a concept design for EDiHTA framework, and the discussion on the most relevant domains and criteria to be considered. CONCLUSIONS: Stakeholders agreed that a harmonized HTA framework is needed; however, differences persist regarding timing and flexibility of evaluation, evidence types, and stakeholder involvement. The EDiHTA project will address differences through framework piloting, supported by multistakeholder workshops and expert advisory groups.
papers.abstract_zh: 目标：在欧洲，数字健康技术（DHTs）的日益普及带来了机遇和挑战。尽管DHTs可能增强护理服务和健康结果，但现有的健康技术评估（HTA）方法往往缺乏灵活性，无法应对其多样化和快速发展的特性。本文探讨了5个利益相关者群体——政策制定者、HTA机构、技术开发者、医疗保健提供者和患者——对于在欧洲地平线资助的欧洲数字健康技术评估（EDiHTA）项目中开发一个协调一致的DHTs HTA框架的观点。方法：研究结果来自混合方法研究，包括对97个欧洲国家利益相关者的调查、访谈和焦点小组讨论。数据分析是按照每个利益相关者群体通过主题分析进行的，以确定共识点，然后确定与EDiHTA开发相关的跨利益相关者的需求和要求，使用创新健康技术评估方法框架。结果：来自8个焦点小组和45多次访谈的结果集中在5个主要主题上。新出现的主题集中在需要协调与DHTs相关的HTA方法、当前最有价值的DHTs特性、多方利益相关者合作的重要性、EDiHTA框架的概念设计原则，以及讨论需要考虑的最相关领域和标准。结论：利益相关者一致认为需要一个协调一致的HTA框架；然而，在评估的时间和灵活性、证据类型以及利益相关者参与方面仍存在差异。EDiHTA项目将通过框架试点来解决这些差异，得到多方利益相关者研讨会和专家咨询小组的支持。

papers.title_en: ‘Most Favored Nation’ Drug Pricing Is An Idea Whose Time Has Come
papers.title_zh: “最惠国”药品定价是一个时代来临的想法
papers.abstract_en: The US pays higher drug prices than do peer nations, thereby financing a disproportionate share of global pharmaceutical research and development. President Donald Trump has announced himself willing to do "whatever it takes" to compress, if not eliminate, the global disparity. In response, major drug firms have hurried to announce price reductions for at least some patients and some products. "Most favored nation" drug pricing as a formal policy faces many political and administrative challenges, but the threat has been effective in driving behavior change by pharmaceutical firms and payers in other nations. This Commentary takes the president seriously, if not literally. It describes the range of instruments available to the administration to pursue its price goals and assesses the tools' potential impact on the rate of investment and innovation in pharmaceuticals. Most favored nation pricing will reduce the revenues available to the industry for research and development, but its impact may be moderated by improved prioritizing of investments and improved efficiency in translating investments into innovation.
papers.abstract_zh: 美国支付的药品价格高于其他国家，因此承担了全球药品研发的不公平份额。唐纳德·特朗普总统已宣布他愿意“不惜一切代价”来压缩，甚至消除全球差异。作为回应，主要药品公司已急忙宣布至少对一些患者和一些产品降低价格。“最惠国”药品定价作为一项正式政策面临许多政治和行政挑战，但这一威胁已有效地推动了其他国家的制药公司和支付者改变行为。本文认真对待总统的话，但不是字面意义上的。它描述了政府为实现其价格目标而可用的工具范围，并评估了这些工具对药品投资和创新速度的潜在影响。最惠国定价将减少该行业用于研发的收入，但其影响可能因投资优先级的提高和投资转化为创新的效率提高而有所缓解。

papers.title_en: US National Spending On Mental Health And Substance Use Disorder Treatment Driven By Case Growth, 2000–21
papers.title_zh: 美国国家心理健康和药物使用障碍治疗支出受病例增长驱动，2000-2021年
papers.abstract_en: Understanding what the US spends to treat mental health and substance use disorders (SUD) is important for understanding spending patterns and informing health policy. In this study, we determined that from 2000 through 2021, mental health and SUD nominal spending grew from $40.9 billion to $139.6 billion. Mental health and SUD accounted for 4.5 percent of all medical services spending in 2000 and 5.5 percent in 2021. Real per capita mental health and SUD spending grew at an average annual rate of 3.27 percent, which was faster than the growth rate for overall medical services (2.21 percent). Our decomposition analysis showed that mental health and SUD spending growth was driven primarily by increases in the number of people receiving treatment (representing 87.3 percent of the growth) and to a much lesser extent by increases in the cost per case (12.7 percent of the growth). However, because disease severity was unobserved, these patterns may partly reflect increased treatment of less severe cases rather than unchanged severity-adjusted treatment costs. During this period, the number of mental health and SUD cases treated grew by 253 percent. In contrast, for spending increases on all diseases, 66.3 percent of the total spending growth resulted from increases in cost per case, and 33.7 percent resulted from more people receiving treatment.
papers.abstract_zh: 了解美国在治疗精神健康和物质使用障碍（SUD）上的支出对于理解支出模式和指导卫生政策至关重要。在本研究中，我们确定从2000年到2021年，精神健康和SUD的名义支出从409亿美元增长到1396亿美元。2000年，精神健康和SUD占所有医疗服务支出的4.5%，到2021年这一比例上升至5.5%。实际人均精神健康和SUD支出的平均年增长率为3.27%，高于整体医疗服务支出的增长率（2.21%）。我们的分解分析显示，精神健康和SUD支出增长主要由接受治疗的人数增加所驱动（占增长的87.3%），而单位成本增加的影响要小得多（占增长的12.7%）。然而，由于疾病严重性未被观察到，这些模式可能部分反映了对较轻病例治疗的增加，而不是调整严重性后治疗成本的不变。在此期间，接受精神健康和SUD治疗的病例数量增长了253%。相比之下，对于所有疾病支出的增加，66.3%的总支出增长源于单位成本的增加，33.7%源于接受治疗的人数增加。

papers.title_en: Variation In Medicaid And Medicare Payment Rates To Community Health Centers, 2023
papers.title_zh: 2023年社区健康中心医疗补助和医疗保险支付率的变化
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, community health centers (CHCs) have struggled to meet the needs of underserved communities because of limited resources and growing demand. Medicaid and Medicare use prospective payment systems (PPSs) to reimburse CHCs at enhanced rates to safeguard their financial stability by providing consistent and predictable payments. However, whether and how these rates vary across centers is unknown. In this study, we conducted the first known analysis of Medicaid and Medicare PPS rates across CHCs by compiling a novel data set from forty-two states and Washington, D.C. We found that Medicaid PPS rates were 23 percent higher, on average, than Medicare PPS rates in 2023. Concerningly, centers that served more patients who identified as non-Hispanic Black, were uninsured, or had more chronic conditions received lower PPS rates. Overall, we observed that payment rates were generally insufficient to offset the average per visit cost of care delivered in CHCs. Standardized policies concerning how public insurance payers reimburse CHCs are needed to promote equity and sustainability in the health care safety net.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，社区卫生中心（CHCs）因资源有限和需求增长而难以满足弱势社区的需求。医疗补助和医疗保险通过预期支付系统（PPSs）以更高的比率向CHCs支付费用，以提供一致和可预测的支付，保障其财务稳定。然而，这些比率是否以及如何在中心之间变化尚不清楚。在这项研究中，我们通过汇编来自四十两个州和华盛顿特区的新数据集，进行了首次已知的医疗补助和医疗保险PPS比率跨CHCs的分析。我们发现，2023年医疗补助PPS比率平均比医疗保险PPS比率高23%。令人担忧的是，服务更多自认非西班牙裔黑人、无保险或有更多慢性病患者的中心收到了更低的PPS比率。总体而言，我们观察到支付比率普遍不足以抵消CHCs中提供的护理的平均每次访问成本。需要制定标准化政策，以规范公共保险支付者如何向CHCs支付费用，以促进医疗安全网的公平性和可持续性。

papers.title_en: Lingering Effects Of The COVID-19 Pandemic On Non-COVID-19 Death Rates In The US, 2020–24
papers.title_zh: 2020-24年美国非新冠肺炎死亡率受新冠肺炎大流行的持续影响
papers.abstract_en: It is not currently understood whether the COVID-19 pandemic led to a lengthy period of elevated mortality rates or whether rates have returned to prepandemic trends. To examine this, I calculated age-adjusted excess mortality rates and percent excess mortality overall, by cause, and for population subgroups. COVID-19 death rates in the US fell 93 percent from 2021 to 2024, whereas excess non-COVID-19 death rates declined just 48 percent, with sustained excess mortality likely in the future, particularly for many natural causes. Suicide death rates did not rise, drug and homicide death rates jumped initially but declined relatively quickly, and transport death rates grew more moderately but showed greater persistence. Demographic-group differences were pronounced, with substantial lasting effects for females, American Indian/Alaska Native people, and seniors. This reflects heterogeneity in the prepandemic composition of deaths and in cause-specific percent excess mortality rates across groups. These results indicate important clinical and policy challenges, especially for natural causes of death and for groups facing relatively high cause-specific excess mortality rates.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前尚不清楚COVID-19大流行是否导致了死亡率长期升高，或者是否已经恢复到大流行前的态势。为了检验这一点，我计算了按年龄调整的超额死亡率和总体超额死亡百分比，按原因和人口亚组划分。从2021年到2024年，美国COVID-19死亡率下降了93%，而非COVID-19超额死亡率仅下降了48%，未来很可能会出现持续的超额死亡，特别是对于许多自然原因。自杀死亡率没有上升，毒品和凶杀死亡率最初激增但相对迅速下降，交通死亡率增长较为温和但显示出更大的持续性。不同人口群体之间的差异显著，对女性、美国印第安人/阿拉斯加原住民和老年人的影响持续存在。这反映了大流行前死亡构成的异质性以及不同群体中特定原因的超额死亡率。这些结果表明了重要的临床和政策挑战，特别是对于死亡的自然原因以及面临相对高特定原因超额死亡率的群体。

papers.title_en: Massachusetts Medicaid Housing Supports Reduced Health Care Costs Among Adults With Behavioral Health Conditions
papers.title_zh: 马萨诸塞州医疗补助住房支持降低患有行为健康问题的成年人的医疗保健成本
papers.abstract_en: In 2020, Massachusetts Medicaid launched the Flexible Services Program (FSP) to fund housing and nutrition assistance services for beneficiaries in accountable care organizations. To evaluate the program's impact on health outcomes for beneficiaries with behavioral health conditions, we compared changes in total health care costs, hospitalizations, emergency department (ED) visits, primary care visits, and hospital readmissions among 6,575 FSP participants enrolled during the period 2020-23 with those of a comparison group of people who were eligible for but did not receive FSP services. We also conducted the analysis with a secondary comparison group of 6,419 similar beneficiaries enrolled in Medicaid managed care organizations that did not offer FSP services. Relative to the primary comparison group, per person health care costs for FSP participants were $2,117 lower six months after beginning the program and $3,260 lower at twelve months. ED visits were 5 percent lower and readmissions were 36 percent lower at twelve months among FSP participants compared with the primary comparison group. Analyses using the secondary comparison group found similar reductions in costs at six months after FSP initiation, larger cost reductions at twelve months, and similar twelve-month declines in readmissions. These findings support the continuation of housing assistance programs for Medicaid beneficiaries with behavioral health conditions.
papers.abstract_zh: 2020年，马萨诸塞州医疗补助启动了灵活服务计划（FSP），为责任医疗组织中的受益人提供住房和营养援助服务的资金。为了评估该计划对患有行为健康问题的受益人健康结果的影响，我们将2020-23年期间注册的6,575名FSP参与者的总医疗保健成本、住院次数、急诊科（ED）访问次数、初级保健访问次数和医院再入院次数的变化与有资格但未接受FSP服务的对照组人员进行了比较。我们还使用了一个次要对照组，包括6,419名类似的受益人，他们注册了不提供FSP服务的医疗补助管理保健组织。与主要对照组相比，FSP参与者的人均医疗保健成本在开始计划后的六个月内降低了2,117美元，在十二个月内降低了3,260美元。与主要对照组相比，FSP参与者在十二个月内的ED访问次数降低了5%，再入院次数降低了36%。使用次要对照组的分析发现，在FSP启动后的六个月内成本降低类似，十二个月时成本降低更大，十二个月的再入院次数下降也类似。这些发现支持继续为有行为健康问题的医疗补助受益人提供住房援助计划。

papers.title_en: ‘Most Favored Nation’ Policies And Value-Based Drug Pricing: A European View
papers.title_zh: “最惠国”政策与基于价值的药品定价：欧洲视角
papers.abstract_en: More than two decades of US purchasers essentially allowing pharmaceutical manufacturers to charge whatever they want have resulted in US companies' global leadership in biomedical sciences. President Donald Trump's proposed "most favored nation" drug pricing policies are causing a shift, whereby drugs' value stops being a national conversation and becomes a mechanical convergence of prices under US pressure and under coming threat of new, fierce competition. Presumably, the proposed policies could lead to higher drug prices in the European Union (EU), but they will hardly generate more income for US pharmaceutical companies, which might even stay away from European markets to avoid having to disclose their EU net prices, unless they develop global breakthrough competitive strategies. The proposals certainly will change EU manufacturers' investment strategies and are already accelerating the polarization of their national price negotiation goals and methods. Within this new geopolitical context, European nations' policies should be driven by a much more holistic and strategic approach to what "value" means.
papers.abstract_zh: 二十多年来，美国采购者基本上允许制药商随意定价，这使得美国公司在全球生物医学科学领域处于领导地位。唐纳德·特朗普总统提出的“最惠国”药品定价政策正在引发转变，药品的价值不再成为国家对话，而是在美国压力和新激烈竞争威胁下的价格机械趋同。假设这些提议的政策可能会导致欧盟药品价格上涨，但它们几乎不会为美国制药公司带来更多收入，这些公司甚至可能为了避免披露其在欧盟的净价格而远离欧洲市场，除非它们发展出全球突破性的竞争策略。这些提议肯定会改变欧盟制造商的投资策略，并正在加速他们国家价格谈判目标和方法的两极分化。在这个新的地缘政治背景下，欧洲国家的政策应该由对“价值”含义的更全面和战略性的方法来推动。

papers.title_en: ‘Most Favored Nation’ Drug Pricing: An Idea To What End?
papers.title_zh: “最惠国”药品定价：这一构想的目的何在？
papers.abstract_en: US prices for brand-name drugs are substantially higher than those in other countries. Recent "most favored nation" proposals aim to simultaneously lower US prices through international reference pricing while increasing prices in other countries toward parity with the US. Although most favored nation policies have some merit, the challenge is for the US to establish the point at which they will have succeeded-that is, when the resulting net prices paid for brand-name drugs are "right" from a US-focused, value-oriented perspective. Without investments in US health technology assessment research, this crucial endpoint will remain difficult to define.
papers.abstract_zh: 美国品牌药品的价格远高于其他国家。最近提出的“最惠国待遇”提案旨在通过国际参考定价同时降低美国药品价格，同时提高其他国家的药品价格，使其与美国持平。尽管最惠国政策有一定的优点，但挑战在于美国需要确定他们成功的点——即从以美国为中心、以价值为导向的角度来看，品牌药品支付的净价格何时是“正确的”。如果不投资于美国卫生技术评估研究，这一关键终点将难以定义。

papers.title_en: Inflation Reduction Act Changes To Part D Plan Design: Lower Premiums, Higher Deductibles, And Some Smaller Formularies
papers.title_zh: 通货膨胀降低法案对D部分计划设计的改变：降低保费、提高自付额以及一些更小的药品目录
papers.abstract_en: The Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) of 2022 changed the financing and risk-bearing obligations of Medicare Part D prescription drug plans in 2025. We used the Medicare 2021-25 public use files to construct a counterfactual trend using 2021-24 data to predict 2025 outcomes if the IRA had not implemented substantial benefit changes. We compared actual deductibles, premiums, and utilization management outcomes in 2025 against outcomes predicted by prior trends for both Medicare Advantage prescription drug (MA-PD) plans and Medicare Part D standalone prescription drug plans (PDPs). We found substantial differences between the predicted inflation-adjusted and population-weighted trend and actual deductibles for MA-PD plans (actual mean, $305.42; predicted mean, $187.54) and for PDPs (actual mean, $490.56 per month; predicted mean, $401.42 per month), as well as a decrease in premiums for MA-PD plans (actual mean, $12.76 per month; predicted mean, $15.02 per month) and for PDPs (actual mean, $39.55 per month; predicted mean, $64.07 per month). No changes were observed for prior authorization or step therapy. Formularies became smaller for protected classes and low-tier drugs in 2025 for PDPs relative to prior trend. No changes in the size of the preferred retail pharmacy networks were observed relative to prior trend.
papers.abstract_zh: 2022年的《通胀削减法案》（IRA）改变了2025年医疗保险D部分处方药计划的融资和风险承担义务。我们使用2021-25年的医疗保险公共使用文件，构建了一个基于2021-24年数据的反事实趋势，以预测如果IRA没有实施重大福利变化，2025年的结果。我们将2025年的实际自付额、保费和利用管理结果与医疗保险优势处方药（MA-PD）计划和医疗保险D部分独立处方药计划（PDPs）的先前趋势预测结果进行了比较。我们发现，对于MA-PD计划（实际平均值，305.42美元；预测平均值，187.54美元）和PDPs（实际平均值，每月490.56美元；预测平均值，每月401.42美元），预测的通胀调整和人口加权趋势与实际自付额之间存在显著差异，同时MA-PD计划的保费有所下降（实际平均值，每月12.76美元；预测平均值，每月15.02美元）和PDPs（实际平均值，每月39.55美元；预测平均值，每月64.07美元）。对于预先授权或阶梯疗法，没有观察到变化。与先前趋势相比，2025年PDPs的受保护类别和低层级药物的药品清单变小了。与先前趋势相比，优选零售药店网络的规模没有变化。
